chronology.execution: first observed one-minute open strictly later than decision availability plus 500ms
chronology.stage_boundary: mark unresolved exposure and retain the global slot

survival: positive exact top-five-positive-event deletion with full one-slot rerouting

event.break: first later completed 15-minute close at least 0.05 prior-only ATR20 through the shelf boundary
event.defended_band: shelf boundary plus or minus 0.10 prior-only ATR20 frozen at second-pivot availability
event.defense_state: completed one-minute turnover whose turnover/volume VWAP lies inside the band divided by all positive turnover between pivot availabilities; at least two distinct 15-minute visits
event.first_defense_survival: the first pivot remains unconsumed by completed 15-minute closes through second-pivot availability
event.retest: first later completed five-minute bar within twelve bars that touches the frozen defended band
event.shelf: latest two causally confirmed same-side 15-minute pivots, 4 bars to 3 UTC days apart, dispersion <=0.10 prior-only ATR20
event.threshold: one pooled calendar-2021 upper quartile of defended-turnover share

logic.thesis: Repeated defense plus actual executed turnover at a narrow shelf identifies accumulated inventory. The first close through the shelf consumes that defense; the first causal retest reveals whether control transferred for continuation or the break failed for reversal.

payoff.continuation_target: nearest still-unconsumed pre-known prior-day or confirmed 4h external pool in the break direction
payoff.hard_stop: one tick plus 0.10 decision ATR20 beyond the full break/retest excursion
payoff.state_exit: first later completed five-minute close through the band against the action, executed after the same latency
